command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Write-Host "===== BOOKMARK ADD DIAGNOSTIC ====="
git fetch origin main work/bookmarks-winui --no-tags --prune
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "git fetch failed" }
if ((git rev-parse origin/main).Trim() -ne "5228cbbfc24f56d61a84975545f1d8572e7deece") { throw "main moved" }
$status=@(git status --short)
if($status.Count -ne 0){$status|%{Write-Host $_};throw "unexpected local changes"}
git checkout work/bookmarks-winui
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "checkout failed" }
git merge --ff-only origin/work/bookmarks-winui
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "branch ff failed" }
$env:FLY_MIGRATION_CONFIGURATION="Release"
$diag=@'
from pathlib import Path
from tests.winui.paths import ROOT, app_exe
import ctypes as c, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, time
from ctypes import wintypes as W
from pywinauto import Desktop
EXE=app_exe("Release")
base=ROOT/"logs"/"bookmark-diagnostic-owned"
shutil.rmtree(base,ignore_errors=True)
source=base/"북마크원본"; appdata=base/"appdata"; localdata=base/"localdata"; temp=base/"tmp"
for p in (source,appdata,localdata,temp):p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
profile=localdata/"flyExplorer";profile.mkdir()
(profile/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_bytes(b"schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=details\r\n")
env={**os.environ,"APPDATA":str(appdata),"LOCALAPPDATA":str(localdata),"TEMP":str(temp),"TMP":str(temp)}
p=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(source)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
u=c.windll.user32
CALL=c.WINFUNCTYPE(W.BOOL,W.HWND,W.LPARAM)
u.EnumWindows.argtypes=[CALL,W.LPARAM];u.GetWindowThreadProcessId.argtypes=[W.HWND,c.POINTER(W.DWORD)]
u.PostMessageW.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.UINT,W.WPARAM,W.LPARAM]
def wins():
 out=[]
 @CALL
 def cb(h,_):
  pid=W.DWORD();u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(h,c.byref(pid))
  if pid.value==p.pid and u.IsWindowVisible(h):out.append(int(h))
  return 1
 u.EnumWindows(cb,0);return out
limit=time.monotonic()+18
while time.monotonic()<limit and not wins() and p.poll() is None:time.sleep(.1)
assert wins() and p.poll() is None
win=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=wins()[0])
el=lambda n:win.child_window(auto_id=n)
limit=time.monotonic()+18
while time.monotonic()<limit:
 try:
  if str(source).lower() in el("AddressBox").get_value().lower():break
 except:pass
 time.sleep(.1)
print("BEFORE_STATUS",el("StatusText").window_text(),flush=True)
print("BEFORE_BUTTONS",[x.window_text() for x in win.descendants(control_type="Button") if "북마크" in x.window_text()],flush=True)
el("AddBookmarkButton").click_input()
time.sleep(.8)
store=profile/"bookmarks-v1.txt"
print("AFTER_STATUS",el("StatusText").window_text(),flush=True)
print("AFTER_BUTTONS",[x.window_text() for x in win.descendants(control_type="Button") if "북마크" in x.window_text()],flush=True)
print("STORE_EXISTS",store.exists(),flush=True)
if store.exists():print("STORE_TEXT",store.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("\r","<CR>").replace("\n","<LF>"),flush=True)
u.PostMessageW(wins()[0],0x0010,0,0);p.wait(timeout=12)
print("EXIT",p.returncode,flush=True)
shutil.rmtree(base,ignore_errors=True)
'@
Set-Content -LiteralPath logs\bookmark-add-diagnostic.py -Value $diag -Encoding utf8
python -X utf8 logs\bookmark-add-diagnostic.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "bookmark diagnostic failed" }
